purpose: Mechanical qualification for a Spring case study. Not a frozen cohort. Not a statistical evaluation. No case is selected in this file.

conditions.required: Java + Maven, and the case can run in the existing Docker sandbox
buggy and fixed revisions exist, and the first parent of fixed equals buggy
a corresponding issue body is available (Issue2Test input)
a production Maven <dependency> groupId contains org.springframework; not a repository-name test
the human fix changed at least one non-test .java file

filtersNotApplied: whether the defect crosses DI, AOP, or event graph edges
PatchGate compatibility as a selection filter
the freeze diagnostic denylist as such
ranking, preference, or any suggested pick

universe.note: Reused the frozen source-gate union. No extra datasets were opened. Every union member already passes C4.

evidence.C1: GitBug-Java Maven case; pom.xml java.version=17; dynamic probe stages warmup_* and offline_* all PASSED under the existing Docker sandbox
evidence.C2: selection-audit.json probe stage parent_revision=PASSED
evidence.C3: passed freeze static filters (not ISSUE_UNAVAILABLE); GitBug-Java issueAvailable requires a non-PR issue with non-blank title and body

C5.method: byte-compare cached buggy vs fixed trees; ignore src/test and target/

additionalInventory.source: existing calibration record; not a member of the source-gate union

evidence.C3: calibration record includes GitHub issue 1326 body
evidence.C4: production module org.springframework.cloud.openfeign (groupId identity, not a repository-name test)
